basis: All-in totals are Booking.com room-table statements ('Gesamt / Includes taxes and charges') re-read live on 2026-11-27 for check-in 2027-02-15, check-out 2027-02-22, 2 adults, 1 room, USD. Pre-tax headline figures are the stated 'Total before taxes' snapshots read 2026-11-26 and are labelled with their own read date; where the 2026-11-26 pre-tax snapshot no longer composes with the 2026-11-27 stated all-in (dynamic rate movement), the all-in governs (flag F-31). NYC fixed nightly fees verified on nyc.gov/DOF 2026-11-27: $2.00 room fee (rent $40+) + $1.50 NYS hotel unit fee = $3.50/night, on top of the 14.75% hotel occupancy tax rate. Reach is Haversine distance across the 22 Manhattan starred venues with verified coordinates.

booking_strategy.winter_outing_2027: NYC Tourism Winter Outing 2027 (Hotel Week 25% off, Restaurant/Broadway/Must-See 2-for-1) runs 2 Jan - 11 Feb 2027 and ends 4 days BEFORE 15 Feb 2027.
booking_strategy.flight_booking_window: Expedia 2026 Air Hacks reports US domestic sweet spot 31-45 days out; Google Flights reports ~39 days US domestic (range 22-57d) and 50-133d international (~129d avg) — Feb 15 AMS-JFK sits squarely in the early-booking window now (~81 days out).
booking_strategy.hotel_booking_window: Lock a $0-prepayment free-cancellation Black Friday hotel rate now (Fairfield cancel free until 2027-02-12) and re-check weekly / mid-Jan 2027 in case shoulder promos drop further.
